reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat edat_lfse_03 pinned isced11=ED5-8 (tertiary as highest attainment), age=Y25-64 (the LFS's adult band), sex=T, unit=PC (the dataset's only unit, pinned and guarded): 36 countries (EU + EFTA + the Balkans + Türkiye; no XK), the door's own per-country starts (Belgium/Denmark/Germany/Greece/ Ireland 1992, France 1993 — the attainment series reach deeper than the probe's pinned window), the collector's b/e/p flags transported as-reported. Witness tier = the Barro-Lee/Lee-Lee long-run panel via OWID's chart door, 153 entities 1870-2010+, 5-year steps. Root pair eurostat_lfs/ barro_lee: the survey print and the reconciled scholarly panel — on the co-covered core they print the same levels to a few points (the panel's partial-tertiary bucket running above the LFS's completed-only face by construction), the seam documented, never blended.

label: Top 1% pre-tax income share
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the World Inequality Database's pre-tax national income top-1% share (DINA research harmonization: fiscal microdata + household surveys + national accounts blended per the 2020/2025 guidelines), reached through OWID's chart door (165 entities, 1820-2024, the chart's own attribution naming WID.world; the direct WID API probed and refused from this environment — every extractor shape 403, the record in sources.yaml). A research-harmonization canonical by necessity: no collector prints the metric anywhere (the probe record). No witness tier — no cross-root machine door exists (the IDD's measure list enumerated live, the extrapolations door refused as same-root modeled). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: the compilation the corpus itself names, displayed as what it is.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OWID chart door = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: World Inequality Database, WID. world's own reuse terms apply upstream).

label: Unemployment rate
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat une_rt_a pinned age=Y15-74/unit=PC_ACT/ sex=T (the LFS questionnaire's own broadest band — the codelist carries no TOTAL; unit PC_ACT is the rate's own denominator, not PC_POP; 1-decimal as published), 38 geos (EU + EFTA + Western Balkans + Turkiye; no UK — post-Brexit the door stopped carrying it), 2003-2025, 635 valued cells, the collector's b/d flags transported as-reported on quality_code (d on FR and ES 2021-2025: the 2021 LFS questionnaire redesign — a definitional seam the connector surfaces, not a geo seam; b = break in series; no provisional codes in this dataset), PLUS the M/F ventilations of the same door (v25: the sex merge-key rows, one pin away each — FR M 2015 = 10.8, F = 9.9) and the two CLASS-decomposition canonical doors (v25: lfsa_urgacob and lfsa_urgan at the same Y15-74 pin, unit PC the datasets' only unit, the class dimension open — 36/35 printing geos, 1995-2025, the étrangers/immigrés boards of Le Destin des immigrés at the collector tier). Witness tier = the WB national-estimate line, 208 countries 1990-2025, 0-3 decimals as printed, PLUS the ILOSTAT class cross-sections (v25: CITIZEN/NONCIT and NATIVE/FOREIGN at 15+, 137/145 areas, ~1 observation per series — the coupe pattern, SOURCE "LFS - Enquête sur l'emploi" and the micro-data-processing repository mix the flow's own annotations carry). Root pair eurostat_lfs/ilo_lfs: same underlying national surveys, one harmonization step apart — on the co-covered core they print the same rates to rounding (FR 2015: 10.4 vs 10.354), and the seams the pair displays (FR 2024 7.436 vs 7.4 rounding; DE 2005 11.193 on the witness vs ABSENT on the collector) read as two doors, never a contradiction.
